request: Pull EPA Air Quality System (AQS) ozone (parameter 44201) hourly sample measurements for California for January 2024, enrich with sample-time-of-day features and trend analysis by site_number + county. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 09 - EPA Air Quality' on Tableau Server for environmental analysts.

sources.name: EPA AQS Ozone California January 2024
sources.description: U.S. EPA Air Quality System (AQS) Data API. Hourly sample measurements for ozone (parameter 44201) across all California monitoring sites for a 3-day demo window (Jan 15-17, 2024). Public test/test credential pair allowed for low-volume access; for higher volume, register at aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/documents/data_api.html. Single-call snapshot (no pagination). Response is wrapped in {Header, Data}.

args.name: Ozone Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from obs_date (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of EPA AQS ozone hourly samples.
args.stats_description: Long-form EPA ozone statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over county and site_number). Includes monthly_count of valid samples, 7-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change (limited use here since the demo window is one month), z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify monitoring sites trending toward exceedance bands.

outputs.name: EPA Ozone Detail
outputs.description: Row-level EPA AQS ozone (parameter 44201) hourly sample measurements for California, January 2024. Includes state, county, site_number, parameter, datetime (date_local + time_local), sample_measurement (parts per million), units_of_measure, sample_duration, method/method_type, lat/lon, county, cbsa_code. Plus calendar features. Source: aqs.epa.gov/data/api. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: EPA Ozone Stats
outputs.description: Long-form EPA ozone statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over county and site_number). Includes 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Source: EPA AQS Data API.
